HR: adjusted Cox HR per sample SD of DISCO or log(DM) in the final common within-cohort analysis sample
C_index: crude apparent Harrell concordance on the same participants; not pooled by the HR meta-analysis
core_adjustment: age+sex+smoking+alcohol+education, additionally race in NHANES and UKB
missing_data_decisions: UKB missing race=White; CHARLS missing binary education=observed scored-cohort mode
endpoint_status: saved cohort definitions retained; raw survival definitions not all finally approved
excluded: overlapping UKB modality samples; logistic OR; old SD denominator; per-unit or differently adjusted HR
